query: I just got accepted into a university in Finland. How much money do I need to show in my bank account for a 1-year student residence permit?
expected_answer: For a one-year residence permit for studies, you must have at least EUR 9,600 at your disposal. This equates to EUR 800 per month. The funds must be in your own bank account and must be freely available to you.

query: My company is hiring me as a senior software engineer in Helsinki. Can I use the fast-track application, and does it apply to my wife and daughter too?
expected_answer: Yes, high-skilled specialists and their family members (spouse and children under 18) can apply together using the 14-day fast-track service in Enter Finland, provided they submit their applications online, pay the fees, and verify their identities at a service point within the specified timeframes.

query: I am marrying a Finnish citizen. Do we need to prove a minimum household income to get my family residence permit?
expected_answer: No. If you are applying for a residence permit on the basis of family ties with a spouse who is a Finnish citizen, you are exempt from the income requirement.

query: I have been living in Finland on an A-permit for 4 years. Am I eligible to apply for a permanent residence permit now?
expected_answer: Yes. You can apply for a permanent residence permit (P-permit) if you have lived in Finland on a continuous residence permit (A-permit) for an uninterrupted period of four years, you still meet the requirements for an extended permit, and you have secure livelihoods.

query: I recently graduated from my Master's program in Finland and just got a job offer. Can I start working immediately before getting my new permit?
expected_answer: Yes. If you apply for a residence permit on the basis of a degree completed in Finland, you have an unrestricted right to work as soon as you submit your application, even before you receive the decision.

query: I registered my application for temporary protection as an Ukrainian national today. Can I start working right away?
expected_answer: Yes. You have an unrestricted right to work immediately after you have registered your application for temporary protection with the police or the border guard. You do not need to wait for the actual residence permit card to arrive.
